Introduction

SECRET NUMBER is a six-member girl group formed by Vine Entertainment. Initially scheduled to debut on March 26, 2020, their debut was delayed due to the global outbreak of COVID-19. The group officially debuted on May 19, 2020, with the single "Who Dis?".

On September 29, 2021, Vine Entertainment announced that member Denise would not participate in the group's upcoming comeback due to ongoing contract negotiations. This was followed by the announcement of the single "Fire Saturday" on October 27, 2021, along with the addition of new members Minji and Zuu.

Denise confirmed her departure from both the group and Vine Entertainment through Instagram on February 5, 2022. Three years later, on April 2, 2025, Vine Entertainment announced on their social media that Léa had chosen to leave the group and company. On April 4, Jinny, Dita, and Minji released a collective statement announcing their departures from the group and company as well.

On August 13, it was announced that four new members would be added to the group ahead of their 8th digital single "Don't Touch". Ebin, Min C, Navi, and Dinda were then revealed through teaser photos within the following days.
